title: Gamma Playbook: How I automate decks with Gamma
caption:
How I automate decks with Gamma

Do this in the next 15 minutes:
1️⃣ Give topic + length — '8-slide deck on client onboarding' — length in the prompt prevents the rambling draft.
2️⃣ Pick a theme — Layout, type, and images arrange themselves — you review the words, not pixel-push the grid.
3️⃣ Rewrite the copy — Treat output as a strong first draft. Your examples and numbers make it credible, not theirs.
4️⃣ Share a live link — One link is the lead magnet — no PDF, no design time, no 'can you resend that?' replies.

Report back after you do it.
